description:
Spends one of the user's RegTail credits to unlock the detailed report for this plate for 30 days, then returns
    the detailed report (as full_report does). Ask the user first, every time, and call this only after they agree; never
    unlock on your own initiative or to answer a general question. A plate already unlocked costs nothing again.
    Needs the user's RegTail account linked. With no credits left it unlocks nothing and spends nothing.

confirmed.description: True only when the user has just said yes to spending one credit on this plate
confirmed.title: Confirmed

plate.description: UK registration plate, any spacing or case
